_doc: Sapphire overworld graphics id -> Black 2 overworld object code, for every graphics_id used by an object_event in external/pokeruby/data/maps/*/map.json (131 ids, 2103 objects; "count" = objects using the id). "code" = Black 2 object code as used in zone entity NPCs (a/1/2/6) and ActorNew: 0-376 people/objects, 0x1000+ Pokemon (a/2/0/8 species table, GetPokemonFieldOBJCODE), 0x2000+ 3D objects; looked up in a/0/4/7 as GetIndexOfObjID. "b2" = what the code is in Black 2. "stand_in": false = Black 2 has this role/species (trainer classes, Pokemon Center staff, obstacles, the same Pokemon, or a generic townsperson for a generic townsperson); true = Black 2 has no such person/thing, the code is the closest look (Hoenn characters, Hoenn-only roles). code null = no usable Black 2 sprite (VAR_* are dynamic). Identities checked against: the trainer class -> object code table in ov012 rodata at 0x0216d9ac (55 pairs of u16 class, u16 code, read by func_ov012_02162490; agrees with all 54 zone trainer class/code uses it covers), zone trainer NPCs (script 3000+n = trainer n, class from data/trainers), Pokemon Center NPCs and their global scripts (zone 435), NPC dialogue in data/field_scripts, and the sheets themselves (python3 converter/sprite_sheet.py b2 FIRST LAST OUT.png). Black 2 sprites only; Sapphire's pictures were only looked at. Review sheet: screenshots/sprite_map.png (python3 converter/sprite_sheet.py review).

_trainer_front_doc: Sapphire trainer pic (TRAINER_PIC_*, pokeruby include/constants/trainers.h) -> Black 2 front trainer sprite (a/0/7/1, sprite s = files 8s..8s+7) and the Black 2 trainer class that shows it (TRAINER_CLASS_RESOURCES, arm9 0x02092394, byte 0 of each 4-byte entry). "art": src/sprites/trainer/front folder (b2tools/sprite_upgrade.py, redrawn from Sapphire's own pic) or "black2" (Black 2's own PWT sprite of the same character, kept). Slots were Unova-only (Team Plasma, Unova Elite Four, Hugh) or unused; none is used by the PWT. Rival battles use classes 0/1 (Nate/Rosa sprites 0/1 -> Brendan/May, b2tools/sprite_art.py).
